name: Digital Twin Universe
title: Digital Twin Universe | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Test where the software will live.
description: Turn an environment profile into an isolated place to exercise your software. Digital Twin Universe helps create, launch, inspect, and manage realistic test environments.
caption: Workflow illustration.
flow_title: Describe it. Launch it. Exercise it.
flow_intro: Turn an environment profile into an isolated place to exercise your software. Digital Twin Universe helps create, launch, inspect, and manage realistic test environments.
steps: Author a profile from your requirements or validate one you already have.
Start the environment, check readiness, run commands, and move files in and out.
Inspect status, update the environment, and tear it down when the work is complete.
detail_title: Expertise your agent can put to work.
details: Exercise a CLI or service in an environment separate from the development machine.
Use profiles with mock service sidecars to test integrations.
Ask for an explanation of launch problems and ordered setup guidance.
prompt: Use Digital Twin Universe to plan an isolated test environment for this project. Read amplifier-digital-twin-universe --help, check the host, and propose a profile. Show me the profile and lifecycle steps before launching.
prerequisites: Python 3.12+ and uv. Incus runs the environments; Docker supports profiles with mock service sidecars. The setup guide covers host preparation.
model_note: Profile authoring, setup planning, diagnosis, and natural-language management use your configured model provider. Explicit lifecycle commands run without a model.
